import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,sys,json,re
lane=Path.cwd();s=Path('sources/1112.6061.txt').read_text();j=s.find('Define w');print('OPT',j);print(s[s.rfind('Conjecture 6.'):s.rfind('Conjecture 6.')+4300])
s=subprocess.run(['pdftotext','-layout','sources/1008.1837.pdf','-'],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'sources/1008.1837.txt'],input=s,text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
j=s.lower().find('ross');print(s[max(0,j-700):j+5000]);print('SUBLATTICE',[(m.start(),s[m.start()-100:m.start()+700]) for m in re.finditer('Conjecture 1',s)])
p={'queries':['Ross sublattice conjecture periodic rigidity counterexample ultrarigid Malestein Theran','"Cones of Weighted and Partial Metrics" conjecture ridge skeleton','Frohmader "Conjecture 6.3" equal constants flag complex']}
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'search1.json'],input=json.dumps(p),text=True,check=True,capture_output=True)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'charge_search.py'),str(lane/'search1.json')],capture_output=True,text=True);print(r.returncode,r.stdout,r.stderr)
